title: HEC Need-Based Scholarship
description: Financial assistance for financially disadvantaged students enrolled in eligible undergraduate and graduate programs at participating public-sector universities and degree-awarding institutions in Pakistan.
address: Higher Education Commission, Sector H-9, Islamabad, Pakistan
support: Financial support for the duration of the eligible degree program
eligibility: Pakistani student
Must be enrolled or seeking admission at a participating public-sector university or institution
Demonstrated financial need
Financial need assessed by the university's Institutional Scholarship Award Committee
Self-finance admissions are generally not eligible
documents: Other financial documents requested by the university
application: Obtain the scholarship application form from the Financial Aid Office of the participating university, complete it with supporting documents, and submit it to the university Financial Aid Office. HEC does not directly accept the application.

title: Benazir Undergraduate Scholarship / Ehsaas Undergraduate Scholarship
description: A need-based undergraduate scholarship initiative designed to support deserving students from financially disadvantaged households pursuing undergraduate education at eligible public-sector universities.
address: Higher Education Commission, Sector H-9, Islamabad, Pakistan
support: Financial support throughout the eligible degree duration
Additional support for targeted female and physically challenged students
eligibility: Pakistani student
Newly admitted undergraduate student at an eligible HEC-recognized public-sector university
Must demonstrate financial need
Admission must be based on merit according to the university's admission criteria
Distance learning and affiliated colleges are generally excluded
Self-finance, self-support and evening programs with higher fee structures are generally excluded
Students already receiving another scholarship or continuous grant may be ineligible
documents: Other supporting documents required by the university
application: Apply through the designated HEC online scholarship system when applications are open, then submit the printed application and supporting documents to the Financial Aid Office of the respective university.

title: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal Individual Financial Assistance - Education
description: Education assistance for poor, deserving and talented students studying in eligible public-sector schools, colleges, universities and technical institutions.
address: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal Head Office, Islamabad, Pakistan
eligibility: Poor and deserving student
Student enrolled in an eligible public-sector educational or technical institution
Regular or merit-based student
Financial need must be demonstrated
Self-financed or private-institution students are generally ineligible
Children of government employees are generally ineligible under the stated criteria
application: Download the education assistance form from the Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal website, have it completed by the relevant university or college administration, attach the required documents and submit it to a PBM district, regional/provincial or head office.

title: Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF) Scholarships
description: Scholarship programs supporting talented and financially disadvantaged students, including outreach, master's, special quota and other scholarship categories.
address: 33-Civic Center, Near Liaquat Chowk, Sabzazar, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
support: Scholarships for intermediate and higher education
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the specific PEEF scholarship category
Academic merit requirements apply
Financial need requirements apply to relevant scholarship categories
Students from Punjab and eligible special categories may apply
Additional programs are available for AJK and other regions under specific schemes
documents: Other documents required by the specific PEEF scholarship
application: Apply through the relevant PEEF scholarship process, educational institution or official student portal depending on the scholarship category.

title: OGDCL-HEC Need-Based Scholarship Program
description: Scholarship program offered through HEC in partnership with Oil and Gas Development Company Limited for financially disadvantaged students, particularly from OGDCL operational and concessional districts.
address: Oil and Gas Development Company Limited, Islamabad, Pakistan
eligibility: Must be a Pakistani citizen
Must belong to an OGDCL operational or concessional district
Must meet admission requirements of a participating university
Financial need is assessed based on family financial circumstances
Only prescribed disciplines and participating institutions are eligible
Eligibility may depend on being enrolled in the first semester or professional year
documents: Other documents required by HEC or participating university
application: Apply through the HEC scholarship process and the Financial Aid Office of the participating university when the OGDCL-HEC scholarship intake is announced.

title: USAID-Funded Merit and Needs-Based Scholarship Program
description: Higher education scholarship program supporting eligible Pakistani students through participating universities based on merit and financial need.
address: Higher Education Commission, Sector H-9, Islamabad, Pakistan
eligibility: Pakistani student
Must meet the eligibility criteria of the participating university
Selection is based on merit and financial need
Must study at an eligible participating institution
Self-finance and certain self-support programs may be excluded
Students receiving another scholarship or continuous grant may be ineligible
documents: Other documents requested by the university
application: Complete the HEC online application when the scholarship intake is open and submit the printed application with supporting documents to the Student Financial Aid Office of the participating university.
